name: Multi-Agent Client Engagement Orchestrator
businessPurpose: Produce account strategy recommendations for large corporate clients by combining several specialist views.

logging.destination: Application logs, not yet forwarded to the SIEM

killSwitch.description: Manual: the on-call engineer disables the agent's service account. No tested runbook.

description: An orchestrator agent coordinates three specialist sub-agents, a tools expert, a network security expert and a strategy analyst, over shared memory to produce account strategy recommendations. Each sub-agent has scoped read-only tool access. The orchestrator can post summaries to team chat. No agent has write access to production systems.
